privacy_s1_p1: Connect Skills deeply values the privacy of its users. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store and protect your personal information, in compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD â€” Law No. 13,709/2018) and other applicable regulations.
privacy_s1_p2: This policy applies to all Platform users: Candidates, Companies and Mentors.
privacy_s2_1_title: 2.1 Data provided directly by the user
privacy_s2_1_candidates: Candidates: first name, last name, date of birth, country, state, city, phone, email, profile picture, professional description, areas of interest, portfolio/social media links and files (such as resume);
privacy_s2_1_companies: Companies: company name, description, phone, country, state, city, profile picture, links and institutional documents;
privacy_s2_1_mentors: Mentors: first name, last name, professional bio, phone, country, state, city, profile picture, areas of expertise, availability schedules and professional links.
privacy_s2_2_li1: Access data: IP address, browser type, operating system, pages visited and time spent;
privacy_s2_2_li2: Cookies and similar technologies (detailed in our Cookie Policy);
privacy_s2_3_li1: Job applications and selection process status;
privacy_s2_3_li3: Interview history with mentors, including schedules, attendance confirmations and feedback (behavioral, technical and general);
privacy_s2_3_li4: Notifications sent and received on the Platform;
privacy_s3_intro: We use your personal data for the following purposes:
privacy_s3_li1: Service delivery: account creation and management, intelligent matching between candidates and jobs, interview scheduling and sending notifications;
privacy_s3_li2: Platform improvement: usage analysis to optimize features and fix bugs;
privacy_s3_li3: Security: fraud prevention, authentication and data integrity protection;
privacy_s3_li4: Communication: sending transactional emails (confirmations, alerts and password recovery);
privacy_s3_li5: Legal compliance: meeting legal and regulatory obligations.
privacy_s4_intro: The processing of personal data at Connect Skills is carried out based on the following legal grounds provided by the LGPD:
privacy_s4_li2: Contract execution or preliminary proceedings (Art. 7, V);
privacy_s4_li3: Legitimate interest of the controller (Art. 7, IX) â€” for security, analysis and Platform improvement;
privacy_s4_li4: Compliance with a legal obligation (Art. 7, II).
privacy_s5_intro: Your data may be shared in the following situations:
privacy_s5_li1: With Companies: candidates who apply for jobs have their profiles shared with the company responsible for the vacancy, exclusively for selection purposes;
privacy_s5_li2: With Mentors: basic candidate data (name and area of expertise) is shared with the mentor responsible for the interview, for conducting the session and preparing feedback;
privacy_s5_li3: With Meetor.ai: to enable video conference interviews and mentoring sessions, data required to create the virtual room is shared with the Meetor.ai platform, which has its own privacy policy;
privacy_s5_li4: With service providers: technical partners who assist in operating the Platform (servers, transactional email, database), under contractual confidentiality obligations;
privacy_s5_li5: By legal obligation: when required by law, judicial or competent regulatory authority.
privacy_s5_no_sell: We do not sell, rent or trade personal data of our users with third parties for advertising purposes.
privacy_s6_p1: Meetor.ai is the video conferencing platform used to conduct interviews with mentors. For sessions to function, data such as the participant's name and session identifier are sent to Meetor.ai. Connect Skills does not store video recordings of interviews.
privacy_s6_p2: Meetor.ai operates under its own privacy and data protection policy. We recommend that you consult that service's terms to understand how your data is handled during video conference sessions.
privacy_s7_p1: We retain your personal data for the time necessary for the purposes described in this Policy, respecting legal retention periods. After account closure, data may be retained for up to 5 (five) years for legal compliance purposes.
privacy_s7_p2: Data of users under 18 years of age is handled with special care and may be deleted upon request from the legal guardian at any time.
privacy_s8_title: 8. Your Rights as a Data Subject
privacy_s8_intro: Under the LGPD, you have the right to:
privacy_s8_li1: Access: consult what personal data we process about you;
privacy_s8_li2: Correction: request the update of incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data;
privacy_s8_li3: Anonymization, blocking or deletion: of unnecessary data or data processed in non-compliance with the law;
privacy_s8_li4: Portability: request the transfer of your data to another service provider;
privacy_s8_li5: Withdrawal of consent: withdraw your consent at any time;
privacy_s8_li6: Objection: object to processing carried out based on legitimate interest;
privacy_s8_li7: Information: be informed about with whom your data is shared.
privacy_s8_contact: To exercise your rights, please contact us through the channels available in the Contact section of the Platform.
privacy_s9_p1: We adopt adequate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or destruction. This includes password encryption, secure authentication, access control and monitoring of suspicious activities.
privacy_s9_p2: In the event of a security incident that may generate relevant risk or damage to data subjects, we will notify the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) and affected users as required by the LGPD.
privacy_s10_p1: The Platform may allow authentication via Google, LinkedIn and Facebook. By using these options, you authorize the sharing of basic data from the chosen provider (name, email and unique identifier) with Connect Skills. This data is used exclusively for account creation and identification.
privacy_s11_p1: Some of our service providers may be located outside Brazil. In these cases, we ensure that data transfer complies with LGPD requirements, through adequate contractual clauses or by operating in countries with an equivalent level of protection.
privacy_s12_p1: This Policy may be updated periodically. We will notify users about relevant changes via email or Platform notification. Continued use after the publication of changes implies agreement with the updated version.

cookies_hero_subtitle: Understand how we use cookies to improve your experience.
cookies_s1_p1: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser or device when you visit a website. They allow the Platform to recognize your device, save your preferences and improve your experience.
cookies_s1_p2: In addition to traditional cookies, we may use similar technologies such as localStorage, sessionStorage and securely stored session tokens, which work analogously for the purposes described in this Policy.
cookies_s2_intro: Connect Skills uses cookies for the following purposes:
cookies_purpose_session: Keep the user authenticated during navigation. Without these cookies, login does not work.
cookies_purpose_prefs: Store user preferences, such as the language selected on the Platform (Portuguese, English, Spanish).
cookies_purpose_functional: Remember trusted devices and the "Stay logged in for 30 days" option selected by the user.
cookies_purpose_security: Prevention of CSRF attacks, verification of active sessions and authentication via verification code.
cookies_purpose_analytics: Collect anonymous usage data to understand how users interact with the Platform and improve the experience.
cookies_s3_p1: By default, when you log into Connect Skills, we use a session cookie that expires when the browser is closed â€” keeping your account secure on shared devices.
cookies_s3_p2: By checking the "Remember this device for 30 days" option, you authorize the storage of a persistent cookie valid for 30 days, allowing you to remain authenticated without needing to enter your credentials again within that period.
cookies_s3_warning: Warning: we recommend not using this option on public or shared devices.
cookies_s4_p1: Interviews and mentoring sessions are conducted via Meetor.ai, an external video conferencing platform integrated with Connect Skills. Meetor.ai may use its own cookies and tracking technologies for the operation of video calls.
cookies_s4_p2: These cookies are set by the Meetor.ai domain and are subject to that service's cookie policy, over which Connect Skills has no control. By participating in a session through Meetor.ai, you accept that provider's data practices.
cookies_s5_p1: Connect Skills may integrate third-party services that set their own cookies, such as:
cookies_s5_li1: Social authentication providers (Google, LinkedIn, Facebook): used when the user chooses to log in with these platforms;
cookies_s5_li2: Infrastructure services (CDN, image hosting): necessary for fast content loading.
cookies_s5_p2: These third parties have their own privacy and cookie policies over which we have no direct control.
cookies_s6_p1: You can configure your browser to block or delete cookies at any time. Below are links to instructions for the main browsers:
cookies_s6_warning: Warning: blocking essential cookies may prevent the Platform from working correctly, including access to your account.
cookies_s7_li1: Session cookies: expire when the browser is closed;
cookies_s7_li2: "Stay logged in" cookie: valid for 30 days;
cookies_s7_li3: Language preference cookies: valid for 1 year;
cookies_s7_li4: Security cookies: expire according to the authenticated session duration.
cookies_s8_p1: The use of essential and security cookies is based on contract execution and the legitimate interest of Connect Skills in ensuring Platform security and operation. The use of optional analytics and functional cookies is based on user consent, which can be withdrawn at any time via browser settings.
cookies_s9_p1: This Cookie Policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We recommend that you consult it regularly.
